name: Pia Nalaar
description: Pia Nalaar is Chandra's mother, a quicksmith and thopter engineer of Ghirapur who led the renegades against the Consulate.

summary.text: Pia Nalaar is Chandra's mother, a quicksmith and thopter engineer of Ghirapur who led the renegades against the Consulate.

bio.text: Baan learned that Pia and Kiran Nalaar were renegade luminaries who had been hunted and reported dead when Bunarat was set ablaze.
Years after her imprisonment in Dhund, she rallied inventors and citizens as the renegades, until Tezzeret seized her at the renegade display and she surrendered to protect Chandra.
Held in Dhund, she was later forced into a duel with Tezzeret in the arena, where Chandra intervened and the Gatewatch protected her.
Free again, she proposed that the renegades capture the Aether Hub, and she confronted Sram, who yielded the Hub.
She led the ground team against the aether turret, and afterward joined the new Consulate leadership as Consul of Allocation.
During the Phyrexian invasion she and Saheeli prepared Ghirapur for the attack, and Pia braced for death on a platform until the Phyrexians suddenly crumbled.
In the Aetherdrift race she worked as the Aether Rangers' mechanic, rescued Chandra and the captive captains, and fought alongside her as Team Avishkar.

status.text: As of the latest story that shows her, Pia is alive, having been seized by guards at Ghirapur and saved when Sita disarmed them, and she is fighting beside Chandra and Sita.

timeline.summary: Baan recognizes Chandra's surname and reveals Pia and Kiran Nalaar were renegade luminaries.
timeline.quote: Pia and Kiran Nalaar were early luminaries of the renegade movement.

timeline.summary: Baan explains that Chandra's parents, hunted after she manifested pyromancy, were reported dead when Bunarat was set ablaze.
timeline.quote: the girl escaped custody when she manifested dangerous pyromantic abilities

timeline.summary: In a Dhund cell Baral tells Pia he killed her daughter and tosses a melted piece of Chandra's vent pack, stamped K.N. and the leaking spire, as a memento (flashback).
timeline.quote: I killed your daughter today, Pia.

timeline.summary: Pia recognizes the fragment as part of Kiran Nalaar's final project.
timeline.quote: a piece of Kiran Nalaar's final project

timeline.summary: Baral returns every day repeating that Chandra was looking for Pia, until Pia vows to return to expose him.
timeline.quote: And I'll return for her, for all those out there, so they know what you've done.

timeline.summary: Pia hurls an aether lamp that knocks off Baral's mask, revealing a blue flash, so he is a mage, and a scarred face.
timeline.quote: dislodged his mask with a clanging reverberation

timeline.summary: Baral blames Chandra for his scars and Pia answers that a mother could not be prouder.
timeline.quote: this is the work of your child.

timeline.summary: Alone in the dark, Pia begins to plan her escape.
timeline.quote: And began to plan.

timeline.summary: Years later, Pia has rallied a contingent of inventors and citizens as the renegades against the Consulate's grip on aether.
timeline.quote: Pia had rallied a growing contingent of inventors, tinkers, artists

timeline.summary: On a rooftop Pia coaches the inexperienced apprentice Tamni through repairing a thopter.
timeline.quote: You'll be fine, but we'll need to be fast.

timeline.summary: Venkat, a former Consulate commander, joins Pia disguised in a lieutenant's uniform.
timeline.quote: Once a high-ranking commander of the Consulate guard forces

timeline.summary: Pia rallies the renegades, listing grievances about the Consulate taking their aether, before the display.
timeline.quote: Let us be as proud, unafraid, unyielding as those who believe they can extinguish our spirits!

timeline.summary: The renegades launch nearly a hundred thopters that form a glittering column over the fairgrounds.
timeline.quote: The machines dove through the air to opposite ends of the plaza, nearly a hundred in number.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret, flanked by automatons and Dovin Baan, seizes Pia with his metal claw.
timeline.quote: The hand that gripped her arm was a massive claw of dark metal

timeline.summary: Tezzeret calls Pia the Renegade Prime and she vows to stop him.
timeline.quote: I've found you at last, Renegade Prime

timeline.summary: Pia sees Chandra, grown and unmistakable, and is flooded with memories.
timeline.quote: Older but unmistakable. Her little girl, now even taller than Kiran had been.

timeline.summary: To protect Chandra, Pia announces herself as the renegade leader and surrenders to Consulate custody.
timeline.quote: My name is Pia Nalaar, leader of the renegades. I'm prepared to enter Consulate custody.

timeline.summary: Soldiers manacle Pia and read out her crimes.
timeline.quote: you are hereby placed under the authority of the Consulate for the following crimes

timeline.summary: Pia kicks and bashes soldiers to draw Chandra's attention and stop her advance.
timeline.quote: You forgot assault!

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Chandra they must retreat as the soldiers drag Pia away.
timeline.quote: They have her! You can't risk it now; we have to go!

timeline.summary: Oviya Pashiri comforts Chandra and says they will free her mother from the Consulate.
timeline.quote: when we find your mother and take her back from those Consulate soldiers, Chandra.

timeline.summary: Mrs. Pashiri tells Yahenni that Pia Nalaar has been captured and asks what he knows.
timeline.quote: Pia Nalaar was captured, you know.

timeline.summary: Yahenni admits he cannot say where the Consulate would hold a prisoner of Pia's standing.
timeline.quote: I don't know where the Consulate would take prisoners of Pia's standing.

timeline.summary: Yahenni reads the enforcer's energy to learn Pia is held in Dhund prison.
timeline.quote: Dhund prison?

timeline.summary: Yahenni tells them Pia is at Dhund and Mrs. Pashiri warns that Baral is stationed there.
timeline.quote: Baral is stationed there.

timeline.summary: Nissa admits she cannot find Pia directly in the tunnels.
timeline.quote: Finding your mother down here is another matter entirely.

timeline.summary: Chandra begs Baral to let the others and her mother go and kill only her, but he refuses.
timeline.quote: Kill me, just me.

timeline.summary: Shadowblayde says she came looking for Renegade Prime and fears the Consuls took them, and offers to take Ajani to a renegade safe house.
timeline.quote: I came here looking for Renegade Prime. She was overdue.

timeline.summary: At the safe house Tamni tells Ajani that Consulate men with a false-armed leader arrested Pia and that Mrs. Pashiri led two women toward Kujar.
timeline.quote: when I got there, the Consulate had her surrounded

timeline.summary: Banners across the city advertise a showdown between Head Judge Tezzeret and the renegade criminal Pia Nalaar the next noon.
timeline.quote: INVENTORS! COME WITNESS THE SHOWDOWN OF THE CENTURY.

timeline.summary: Pia, manacled backstage at the same arena where Chandra was almost executed, hopes her daughter stays away.
timeline.quote: This was the place where Chandra had searched the stands for her mother before being torn out of the world.

timeline.summary: Baral taunts Pia, telling her Chandra's rescue attempt went awry in the wrong place.
timeline.quote: They came looking for you. In the entirely wrong place, sadly.

timeline.summary: The duel starts with Pia and Tezzeret each given a container of basic parts.
timeline.quote: Let the showdown...begin!

timeline.summary: Pia's booby-trapped servo destroys the legs of Tezzeret's crawler.
timeline.quote: The servo burst in a small sphere of smoke and pieces, and blew the legs off the crawler.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret's devices devour her parts, kill her thopter and he summons an army of automatons around her.
timeline.quote: Bands of metal curved unnaturally at his will, coiling in on themselves to become a small squad of other sharp-legged automatons.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret declares he will mete out justice and sets his automaton to kill Pia.
timeline.quote: I will mete out proper justice for yours.

timeline.summary: A bolt of fire from the audience fells the attacking automaton; Chandra has intervened.
timeline.quote: The bolt of fire had streaked out of the audience

timeline.summary: Chandra leaps into the arena, refusing her mother's order to leave and declaring she will not lose her again.
timeline.quote: And I'm not losing you again!

timeline.summary: The planeswalkers battle Tezzeret's automatons while Ajani and Gideon protect Pia.
timeline.quote: Fire flew, slamming like fists into Tezzeret's machines, felling one after another.

timeline.summary: Nissa tells Chandra it is over, and Chandra runs into her mother's arms.
timeline.quote: Her mother held her arms open. Chandra ran and fell into them.

timeline.summary: Saheeli tells Chandra and Pia that the inventions of the Fair and Rashmi are gone.
timeline.quote: I think they took Rashmi and the others

timeline.summary: Pia says Tezzeret's duel was a distraction and Ajani says he is building something.
timeline.quote: He's building something

timeline.summary: Tezzeret says the Gatewatch interrupted his duel and disappeared with the renegade.
timeline.quote: I was referring specifically to the gang of six Planeswalkers who interrupted that duel and disappeared with the renegade.

timeline.summary: The cloaked figure is revealed as Tezzeret, who was stalking Pia Nalaar; Chandra and Pia, each thinking the other dead, are shocked, and the Consulate takes Pia prisoner.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret, Dovin, and Consulate enforcers take Pia prisoner, accusing her of leading the renegade threat.

timeline.summary: At the Grand Exhibition Chandra runs into the arena and the Gatewatch support her against Tezzeret, who slips away; Pia is safe.
timeline.quote: Just when they think they have Tezzeret cornered, he slips away.

timeline.summary: The enforcer repeatedly shocks and kicks the unconscious Nived while demanding what Yahenni knows about six renegade sympathizers, including Pia Nalaar's daughter.
timeline.quote: I'm looking for six individuals that are sympathetic to the renegades' cause.

timeline.summary: Yahenni blackmails Gonti with the secret of their manufactured heart, asking where Chandra and Pia Nalaar are hiding.
timeline.quote: "If you tell me where they are hiding, I will keep the secret of your manufactured heart to myself.

timeline.summary: Nissa has Gideon call back Chandra, who walked the wrong way, and directs the group to Yahenni's home and sends word to Ajani, Pia and Mrs. Pashiri.
timeline.quote: Tell Chandra Yahenni's home is that way, and have Jace inform Ajani, Pia, and Mrs. Pashiri of our new location

timeline.summary: A thopter signals Gideon that Pia has news, and he returns to Yahenni's penthouse.
timeline.quote: Gideon sighed. Pia had news.

timeline.summary: Chandra agrees to focus on stopping Tezzeret, while also helping her mother as Pia Nalaar's daughter.
timeline.quote: And, as much as I hate it, I'll try to focus on stopping Tezzeret....for now.

timeline.summary: Ajani and the rest of the group arrive after hearing the commotion.
timeline.quote: "We all heard the commotion."

timeline.summary: Pia proposes the renegades capture the Aether Hub to cut power to the Spire, and reveals they have a big invention only needing aether.
timeline.quote: "We take the Aether Hub."

timeline.summary: Gideon assigns roles: Pia and Chandra mobilize the renegades while he, Nissa, Jace and Ajani create disruption against the Consulate.
timeline.quote: We're going to run disruption until the renegades are ready to begin the assault.

timeline.summary: Pia brings Chandra to an aetherborn club protected by Gonti where sympathetic inventors gather, asking Chandra to give the speech to spark rebellion.
timeline.quote: Chandra, I want you to do it.

timeline.summary: The crowd erupts into angry complaints about what the Consulate took from them, nearly becoming a riot.
timeline.quote: The spark had caught quickly, and within minutes; the club threatened to become a riot

timeline.summary: An aetherborn emissary calms the crowd and leads Pia, Chandra and others down a secret tunnel to meet Gonti.
timeline.quote: revealing a tunnel and a descending set of stairs.

timeline.summary: Chandra accuses Gonti of betraying them, but Gonti says he pushed them to act and offers the contents of his storeroom for the insurrection.
timeline.quote: I believe I have what you'll need for your little insurrection.

timeline.summary: Pia confronts Sram, who yields the Aether Hub to the renegades.
timeline.quote: "Then I yield," said Sram. "The Aether Hub is yours."

timeline.summary: The renegades return victorious; Pia announces the Hub is won and calls on them to bring down Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: "We've won the day!" Pia cried to more cheers.

timeline.summary: Rashmi dedicates the skyship as the Heart of Kiran, and Mitul and Rashmi remain to pursue temporal aether research.
timeline.quote: So I dedicate this skyship the Heart of Kiran,

timeline.summary: Kari tells Jace she fights for pay as well as the cause; Jace says he is here only for Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: I don't fight for freedom, and I certainly don't fight for free.

timeline.summary: At First Launch, Ukti reveals that Pia's group lost the Aether Hub and leads Kari and Jace to her secret sanctum.
timeline.quote: "Pia's group lost the Aether Hub. They're all scattered now.

timeline.summary: Pia, Saheeli and Rashmi reveal Hope of Ghirapur, a modified thopter carrying an aetheric disruptor to cripple the Planar Bridge.
timeline.quote: "Rashmi and Saheeli have designed a specially modified thopter," said Pia.

timeline.summary: Pia warns that a huge aether turret at the Spire's base can destroy anything that flies and proposes a ground team to take it out.
timeline.quote: "I might have a way to take it out," Pia said.

timeline.summary: Gideon keeps Chandra on the ship while Nissa and Ajani join Pia on the ground team.
timeline.quote: "I'll go along with the ground team," Ajani said.

timeline.summary: Pia's team meets Mrs. Pashiri, who gives them a crate containing a weapon against the turret, and brings renegade inventors.
timeline.quote: "A weapon against the Consulate," Mrs. Pashiri said.

timeline.summary: The ground team fights through automata and peacewalkers around the turret; Shadowblayde is caught in a peacewalker's treads.
timeline.quote: She lost her footing and fell sideways, dragged toward the spikes as she struggled to release herself.

timeline.summary: The renegades release dozens of gremlins that devour the turret's aether and disable it.
timeline.quote: Torn open and drained, the turret went dark and the cannon sagged, aetherless and useless.

timeline.summary: Ghirapur celebrates a new Consulate leadership that includes Pia Nalaar.
timeline.quote: One that included even "Renegade Prime" herself, Pia Nalaar.

timeline.summary: Pia and Chandra walk through the ruined Dhund to the intact core.
timeline.quote: Pia and Chandra Nalaar made their way through the ruined hallways toward the compound's intact core.

timeline.summary: Pia and Chandra visit the cell of the scarred, imprisoned Baral, who demands his execution and goads Chandra to kill him.
timeline.quote: "Baral." Pia said.

timeline.summary: Baral taunts Chandra about her father's death, but she refuses to be a monster and leaves him to be forgotten.
timeline.quote: "Screw you," she said. "I don't owe you a damn thing."

timeline.summary: Pia tells Baral that they leave him; Chandra leaves a jasmine flower at the cell.
timeline.quote: "My daughter and I leave you today," Pia said. "Stay and be forgotten."

timeline.summary: Pia and Chandra repair the mosaic of Kiran; Chandra offers to stay, but Pia insists she go and return, revealing she made shrines to both Chandra and Kiran.
timeline.quote: We can stop being a family of leaving, and become a family of arriving.

timeline.summary: Chandra tells her mother she is going to Amonkhet and says goodbye.
timeline.quote: "To Amonkhet. Someplace I've never been."

timeline.summary: Chandra, sleepless and troubled, looks over Ghirapur from the Hub and misses her mother.
timeline.quote: Now she's back, somewhere up above me, just a little bit away.

timeline.summary: Pia embraces Chandra, telling her she cannot lose her again.
timeline.quote: "I can't lose you again."

timeline.summary: Pia recalls Saheeli's warning of an invasion and the Phyrexian eye symbol appearing everywhere.
timeline.quote: We have to be ready for an invasion,

timeline.summary: Pia and Saheeli address the consulate and prepare Ghirapur, evacuating citizens and arming skyships.
timeline.quote: If Pia allocated the resources to fight, then fight they would.

timeline.summary: The portals open and the invasion spines descend onto Kaladesh.
timeline.quote: the great spines of invasion descended from the holes they tore in reality

timeline.summary: A branch wraps around Ghirapur's flagship and destroys it.
timeline.quote: She watches as the branch wraps around the ship

timeline.summary: Saheeli's Operation Golden Scales deploys bronze lizards that clash with Phyrexian soldiers, and she rescues Pia.
timeline.quote: Deployment chambers spring up from hatches all along the street

timeline.summary: Saheeli and Pia race to the reservoir, noting the Phyrexians are heading there and that converted guards cannot yet be saved.
timeline.quote: We can't do anything to save them,

timeline.summary: Saheeli evades telling Pia what happened to Chandra.
timeline.quote: Pia's been around politicians long enough to know when she isn't getting the whole story.

timeline.summary: Baji offers his skimmer and Pia boards it, but a Phyrexian quill kills him and the skimmer plummets with Pia at the controls.
timeline.quote: a javelin punches through the window and impales him through the chest to his seat

timeline.summary: On Kaladesh, Pia Nalaar braces for death on a platform when the Phyrexians suddenly crumble and she thanks Chandra.
timeline.quote: All over Ghirapur it is the same: the Phyrexians are falling.

timeline.summary: Spitfire arrives at the Aether Rangers' garage where screens show Chandra Nalaar.
timeline.quote: Chandra Nalaar's face is smiling across all their screens.

timeline.summary: Pia Nalaar reveals she has upgraded Spitfire's racer with advanced aether systems.
timeline.quote: A ten-cylinder aether inverter system, two separate cyclonic mitigators

timeline.summary: Chandra says she wishes her mother the best as long as it is second place.
timeline.quote: I wish her all the best, as long as 'the best' is second place.

timeline.summary: Pia calls them to breakfast and teases Chandra as her turncoat daughter.
timeline.quote: Don't deprive me of one last breakfast with my turncoat daughter.

timeline.summary: Pia laments that Chandra will not wear an Aether Ranger uniform.
timeline.quote: Of course, she won't be wearing an Aether Ranger uniform.

timeline.summary: Pia gives Spitfire a new aether-powered racing suit.
timeline.quote: Beneath it, she finds a new racing suit.

timeline.summary: Pia explains the suit's aether capsules grant two seconds of enhanced speed.
timeline.quote: With one of those capsules in your system, you'll be quicker than the gods for about two seconds.

timeline.summary: Pia admits the suit was sized for someone else, implying Chandra.
timeline.quote: It's because I'm taller than her, isn't it?

timeline.summary: Spitfire sees Pia talking to the dead Champion who has been raised.
timeline.quote: Her attention is focused on a member of the Champions: a dark-skinned man with gold-adorned dreadlocks.

timeline.summary: Pia explains that Khuru is the first raised in the race after giving his life for Zahur.
timeline.quote: That young man, Khuru, is the first one they've raised during this race.

timeline.summary: Pia orders Spitfire to pull into the valley and Spitfire obeys.
timeline.quote: She turns toward the valley.

timeline.summary: Chandra's ride is crushed by a dinosaur and Spitfire sees her clinging to a raptor.
timeline.quote: The younger Nalaar's ride is crushed underfoot by a rampaging dinosaur.

timeline.summary: Spitfire switches off her radio and leaves Chandra behind.
timeline.quote: With a flick of a switch, Spitfire switches off her radio.

timeline.summary: Pia crumbles a raider as he finds Chandra hiding in Daretti's vehicle.
timeline.quote: the raider ends up crumbling to the ground like a stack of pebbles.

timeline.summary: Pia picks the cage lock and frees Loot and Daretti.
timeline.quote: And, sure enough, Chandra's mom has the lock figured out all before Daretti has even realized there's anything going on behind him.

timeline.summary: Chandra sets off a fireball that blows up half the raiders' camp as they escape.
timeline.quote: As half of the camp explodes, she hops into the ride with the others.

timeline.summary: Following Loot's cue, Chandra steers left into a tree whose bark falls away to reveal an Omenpath.
timeline.quote: Beneath it, the spiraling light of an Omenpath.

timeline.summary: They crash across the border into a different world.
timeline.quote: A second later, they crash over the border into a different world.

timeline.summary: The rocket car spirals out of the Omenpath above an oasis on Amonkhet instead of reaching Avishkar.
timeline.quote: the rocket car spirals into the air above an oasis on Amonkhet

timeline.summary: The car crashes into the oasis.
timeline.quote: An instant later, the ship hits the earth.

timeline.summary: Chandra wakes first, concussed, and checks on the others.
timeline.quote: Chandra's the first one to wake beneath the warm sun of Amonkhet.

timeline.summary: Daretti offers medicine for the concussions and hands Chandra a cup.
timeline.quote: If you need medicine, I've plenty.

timeline.summary: Daretti concludes the engine is blown and they must improvise from scrap.
timeline.quote: I regret to inform you we've blown the engine.

timeline.summary: Pia assigns Chandra to be her welding torch.
timeline.quote: are going to be your dear sweet mother's personal welding torch.

timeline.summary: Daretti, Pia and Chandra build an all-new engine from palm fibers, hippo bones and scrap.
timeline.quote: I believe we're developing an all-new type of engine here, purely out of desperation.

timeline.summary: Daretti takes over the night work on the engine.
timeline.quote: I think that's most of the welding work done for the evening.

timeline.summary: Pia asks why Chandra did not race with the Aether Rangers.
timeline.quote: why didn't you want to race with us?

timeline.summary: Chandra confides she feared losing Nissa's second chance at a spark and fears telling her she failed.
timeline.quote: We can't lose her second chance at a spark, too.

timeline.summary: Pia comforts Chandra, saying they improvise and find other ways when things do not work out.
timeline.quote: We find other ways to be.

timeline.summary: Pia hot-wires the cobbled-together car.
timeline.quote: Pia's rubbing two wires together beneath the steering wheel.

timeline.summary: Chandra says Ketramose gave directions to an Omenpath.
timeline.quote: Ketramose said if we head this way for an hour or two, we should see it

timeline.summary: Falling toward Ghirapur, Chandra sees the crowd panicking instead of celebrating.
timeline.quote: But as she realizes that the masses below are not celebrating but panicking, a different feeling takes hold.

timeline.summary: Pia identifies the guards below as Consulate thugs.
timeline.quote: From the colors, those are Consulate thugs

timeline.summary: Chandra scorches a roof to slow the falling car, then jumps clear.
timeline.quote: She aims for a sturdy-looking roof instead, then scorches the side of the same building all the way down to try and slow them down.

timeline.summary: Guards seize Pia and put a blade to her throat as Chandra is dragged away.
timeline.quote: The guards grab Pia by the hair, put a blade to her throat

timeline.summary: Sita breaks free and disarms the guards to save Pia.
timeline.quote: Sita throws off the hands keeping her in place, rushes past her hapless father, and dives straight for Pia Nalaar.

timeline.summary: Chandra, Pia and Sita fight together as Team Avishkar.
timeline.quote: Engine, wheels, and transmission. Chandra, Pia, and Sita.

timeline.summary: Nissa finds Chandra, Pia and Sita collapsed.
timeline.quote: Crumpled before the remnants of a great ship: Chandra, Pia, and that other girl she'd seen on the broadcast.

timeline.summary: Sita reveals her father Mohar is in jail for attempting a coup.
timeline.quote: Considering he's in jail, I think he has worse things to worry about

relations.note: He hunted her family and imprisoned her.
relations.quote: The voice of the man who had hunted her family: Captain Baral.

relations.note: A defected commander who trusts her.
relations.quote: I'm just one of many wise enough to place their trust in you

relations.note: He hunts and arrests the Renegade Prime.
relations.quote: I've found you at last, Renegade Prime
That is Pia Nalaar's daughter, Chandra,

relations.note: He defeats and tries to kill her in the duel.
He taunts her before the duel.
relations.quote: Ready to do your part, Nalaar?
he was actually stalking his own quarry: Pia Nalaar
"Happy to have you there. I heard you found your parent."
Pia's late partner, and the inventor who had designed this ship so long ago.

relations.note: Gonti keeps the club off patrol routes and offers supplies.
relations.quote: Gonti keeps this place off the Consulate patrol routes.

relations.note: Kari says Pia is like a second mom.
relations.quote: Pia and I are pretty close. She's like a second mom to me.
one of her old renegade contacts, Baji

pages_say.description: A renegade luminary and, per Baan, Chandra's mother, reported dead after the Bunarat manhunt.
Chandra's mother, long thought dead, a quicksmith who leads the renegades of Ghirapur against the Consulate and is arrested at the end.
The most dangerous person in Ghirapur according to Yahenni, captured by the Consulate and held in Dhund.
Chandra's mother, held prisoner in the Dhund.
The renegade leader arrested by Consulate inspectors in a trap.
Chandra's mother and the renegade leader, forced to duel Tezzeret in the arena as bait.
The renegade leader freed by the Gatewatch from the duel.
Chandra's mother, thought dead, accused by the Consulate of leading the renegade threat.
Chandra's mother, a criminal in the Consulate's eyes, now free and meeting other renegades.
Chandra's mother and a renegade leader who plans the capture of the Aether Hub.
The renegade whose showdown with Tezzeret was a cover for taking the winning inventors.
Chandra's mother and a renegade leader who leads the strike on the Aether Hub.
The renegade leader whose group lost the Aether Hub; Kari calls her a second mom.
Chandra's mother and a renegade leader who leads the ground team against the turret.
Chandra's mother, a thopter engineer and renegade leader who now sits among the new Consuls.
Chandra's mother and a renegade leader who embraces her after the battle.
Chandra's mother, a leader in Ghirapur who prepares the city against the invasion.
Chandra's mother, a Kaladeshi who braces for death on a platform until the Phyrexians fall.
Chandra's mother and a mechanic who tunes Spitfire's racer.
Chandra's mother, a former renegade leader and Aether Rangers mechanic who gives Spitfire a new racing suit.
Chandra's mother and the Aether Rangers' mechanic who checks on Khuru.
Chandra's mother who orders Spitfire to the valley, then rescues Chandra and the captive captains.
Chandra's mother and a former rebel who helps rebuild the rocket car and comforts Chandra.
Chandra's mother who joins Team Avishkar and is nearly killed by a guard.
A person whose features Ajani sees echoed in Chandra's face.
